name: Caos Primordial
description: One cosmic pulse attack: the central eclipse contracts, broken orbital arcs and tendrils pull inward, then expand abruptly in a radial bone-silver energy shockwave, and settle back to the original silhouette. No humanoid limbs. Preserve the exact source sprite identity, outfit, weapons, size and crisp pixel art palette. All motion fits inside the canvas. Fixed front orthographic camera, no translation, no rotation of camera, no zoom, transparent background.
